topic: Removing forecast for specific station category
summary_markdown: Someone requested assistance with removing a forecast. Specifically, the user needs to remove or be shown how to remove the forecast for 'афа' (AFA) stations at the railway station location, limiting the removal only to the 'Rail' category within the 7600 scope.
decisions: The forecast for AFA stations at the railway station must be removed/disabled.
action_items: Someone needs to provide instructions or perform the removal of the specified forecast data.
